rejected: not an allowlisted object: its zone is in the mutator code (hammer_throw block); the returning lifetime is the serialized cap (D?)
rules: ticks = number of damage ticks of a RepeatedlyDamageEnemiesWithinRadius object over its lifetime: RepeatedlyDamageEnemiesWithinRadius.OnUpdateTick adds dt to its index and hits when the index exceeds damageInterval (index -= damageInterval, one tick per frame); DestroyAfterDuration.OnUpdateTick ends the object on the first update that starts with age >= duration.
tick k needs the accumulated age to exceed k * interval, so ticks = floor(lifetime / interval) (an epsilon keeps exact multiples); damageAtStart preloads the index: one more tick at once.
the enemy is assumed to stay inside the radius for the whole lifetime (user decision 4, D?).

lifetime of an object = its serialized DestroyAfterDuration.duration times (1 + the skill's duration increase) (BlackHoleMutator.Mutate: (duration + addedDuration) * (1 + increasedDuration), halved when halfDuration).
objects are listed only when their mutator code is read (ALLOWLIST) and no Destroy* component other than DestroyAfterDuration can end them early (prefab_trap_spawn_relations).

the Hammer Throw object also gets DestroyOnInanimateCollision in code when it does not ignore terrain (HammerThrowMutator.Mutate); the terrain contact depends on the play, so the serialized lifetime is the maximum and is used (D?).
